name: Space Center Houston
desc: Touch a moon rock, tour real Mission Control. 'Houston' means this place. Save up — it's worth the launch.

name: Buffalo Bayou Park
desc: Skyline views, a bat colony at dusk, kayaks under the towers. Free therapy with mosquito DLC.

name: The Menil Collection
desc: World-class art, permanently free, hiding in leafy Montrose. The Rothko Chapel next door will rewire you.

name: Houston Museum of Natural Science
desc: Dinos downstairs, a gem vault that makes rappers jealous. Hunt the free-hours window like a raptor.

name: Museum of Fine Arts, Houston
desc: Two buildings joined by a glowing light tunnel, plus free Thursdays. The tunnel selfie is a rite of passage.

name: Houston Zoo
desc: Giraffe feeding for a few bucks extra — lettuce from your hand, mild judgment from their eyes.

name: Discovery Green
desc: Downtown's front lawn: free concerts, an ice rink in 'winter', food trucks circling like friendly sharks.

name: Gerald D. Hines Waterwall Park
desc: A 64-foot horseshoe of falling water. Free mist facial, engagement-photo magnet, weirdly hypnotic.

name: Kemah Boardwalk
desc: Gulf-side rides and seafood a short drive out. Walking the boards is free; the wooden coaster will taunt you.
